title.native: 東京リベンジャーズ 聖夜決戦編

description:
Despite his best time-leaping efforts, Takemichi Hanagaki continuously fails to prevent the present-day death of Hinata Tachibana, his adolescent love. The adult Takemichi grapples with grief and the ramifications of the Tokyo Manji gang's criminal empire—an unintended product of his timeline meddling. Though the gang once operated under the idealistic Manjirou "Mikey" Sano, it has now been taken over by the malicious Tetta Kisaki and, as a result, has abandoned its original optimistic intent.

Despite feeling hopeless, Takemichi travels to the past once again to investigate Black Dragon, a rival motorcycle gang whose actions ultimately lead to Hinata's demise. There, he meets the young Hakkai Shiba, a fellow gang member whose older brother, Taiju, tyrannically rules Black Dragon.

Takemichi, with Chifuyu on his side, works to unravel the fates of Black Dragon's members, fighting to create a happy future for his loved ones.

(Source: MAL Rewrite, edited)

__Height:__ 162 cm

He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang.
 
Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened.

~!Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!~

__Height:__ 168 cm

Chifuyu is the vice-captain of the First Division of Tokyo Manji gang and [Baji](https://anilist.co/character/145343)'s best friend.

~!He is the first one to get to know about [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342)'s time leap ability. After that, he regularly helps Takemichi to think about saving the future.!~

~!Takemichi sought his help in order to team up and face Kanto Manji, the newest [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341)'s gang. He also demands that their team should be called Thousand Winters. Chifuyu also made the uniforms.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Draken is [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s best friend and one of the founders of Toman. 

Draken is a muscular teenager who is exceptionally tall for his age. His head is shaven on the sides and back to expose his signature dragon tattoo on his left temple. His blonde hair is long on the top of his head and kept in a neat braid. Draken is a serious teen who lives in a brothel, he does not know his biological parents and was 'taken in' by the owners of the brothel.

~!His mother was a prostitute who abandoned him at birth and died when he was two years old.!~

~!In the future, Draken owns a bike shop, and is a member of Brahman.!~

__Height:__ 175 cm

Captain of the 1st division and one of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.

Baji has a wild personality. He loves the thrill of adrenaline and [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341) himself says that he would punch someone out on the street for no apparent reason, only because he feels like it. In combat, he is never without his trademark grin.

__Height:__ 170 cm

Mitsuya is the Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He is a calm, levelheaded person who is also the source of positivity in the gang. Despite his rough upbringing, he tackles every day with a smile. Mitsuya is a pacifist, preferring to not get into an altercation if possible, but at the same time, will not hesitate to fight in order to protect what is dear to him.

Older brother of [Luna Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/272864/Mitsuya-Luna) & Mana Mitsuya. He is a childhood friend of [Draken](https://anilist.co/character/145345/Ken-Ryuuguji).

__Height:__ 165 cm

Takemichi learns that the girl he dated in middle school—the only girl he ever dated—has died. Then, after an accident he finds himself in a time leap back to his middle school years. He vows to change the future and save the girl, and to do that he aims to rise to the top of the Kantou region's most brutal delinquent gang.

~!After the fight with Valhalla he becomes the First division Capitan of Toman.!~

~!He later became the eleventh President of the Black Dragons as well as the captain of the First Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang, and a member of Brahman.!~

~!Takemichi is also the president and founder (with [Chifuyu Matsuno](https://anilist.co/character/145344/Matsuno-Chifuyu)) of the Thousand Winters (later renamed as Tokyo Manji), created to defeat Kanto Manji.!~

__Height:__ 174 cm One of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang and former number 3 of Valhalla. Kazutora is a very broken soul; as a child, he was forced to pick between his mom and dad in a case of domestic violence. As a result of his fundamentally non-existent family life, he scorned upon other happy families. Something as simple as seeing children having tender moments with their parents, triggered a sore spot within Kazutora and irritated him deeply. ~!He sat 2 years in juvie for the murder of Shinichirou Sano, and he is expected to face at least 10 years in juvie, for stabbing Keisuke Baji. Even though they were the most important people in Mikey's life, he still forgave Kazutora, and told him that he is a part of Toman.!~

__Height:__ 153 cm

Hinata Tachibana is the girlfriend of [Takemichi Hanagaki](https://anilist.co/character/145342/Hanagaki-Takemichi) who is the primary reason for Takemichi's desire to change the past. In 2005, Hinata is a 14 year old girl. 

Hinata has light brown eyes and wears her rosy brown hair a little longer than before: it goes beyond her shoulders. She is seen wearing a long black dress with embroidered flowers. She also wears a necklace around her neck, materializing her relationship with Takemichi Hanagaki during their middle school years.

Hinata has a very outgoing and upbeat personality who is highly optimistic and always finds ways to make undesirable situations better. Even when others become demoralized or despair, Hinata remains strong in order to push them forward.

~!On July 4, 2017, Hinata will be killed during a brawl between two Tokyo gangs, along with her brother [Naoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/167843/Tachibana-Naoto).!~

__Height:__ 165 cm

Due to his years alone, Izana became ruthless and cruel. Not only has he become mentally unstable but, he strives for absolute power. Izana is the former leader of the eighth generation Black Dragons as well as the former president of Tenjiku. He is one of the main antagonists of The Tenjiku Arc.

__Height:__ 170cm

Vice captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He's the younger twin brother of [Nahoya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168679/Nahoya-Kawata).

__Height:__ 170 cm

Captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. Brother to [Souya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168678/Souya-Kawata).

__Height:__ 177 cm

Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander and the current vice captain of the Black Dragons.

Inupi is usually a stoic and quiet individual. However, he isn't afraid to voice his thoughts and opinions even if it hurts him in the end. He is very committed to the Black Dragon and loyal to [Kokonoi](https://anilist.co/character/170480/Kokonoi-Hajime), whom he considers his best friend. When he finds people he trusts, he devotes himself to them. He is brave, but will be willing to show his vulnerable side and open up.

__Height:__ 148 cm (past), 175 cm (present)

Hinata's younger brother. He very much resembles his father.

Naoto is a righteous individual who is also determined to also save his sister. He has a no-nonsense personality and is usually unamused by others' humorous advances. He is also willing to embrace far-fetched possibilities, such as the fact that Takemichi can time-travel, and even make his own hypotheses about it.

~!Before the first time travel, he died together with Hinata. However, after he was warned of his death by Hanagaki and was subsequently saved, he grew up to become a detective and ended up playing a key role in Hanagaki's ability to travel through time.!~ ~!Naoto is the key to activating Takemichi's supernatural time-travel ability. Whether in the past or present, as long as the two shake hands, Takemichi will be transferred to the present (if he is in the past), or the past (if he is in the present). He is also the only person who is aware of the consequences caused by Takemichi's time-traveling aside from Takemichi thus far.!~

__Height:__ 192cm

He is the former acting leader of Moebius following Osanai's defeat.

Hanma's single purpose is to find excitement, relieving his boredom by street violence. Hanma slowly sinks in to apathy since he was winning fights easily, without any resistance, that's why he sooner ally with [Kisaki Tetta](https://anilist.co/character/170483).

__Height:__ 150 cm
~![Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s younger half-sister.!~~!Killed by [Tetta Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/170483/Tetta-Kisaki).!~

__Height:__ 183 cm

Vice Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. The younger brother of [Yuzuha](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) and the younger brother of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Taiju-Shiba), the leader of the 10th Generation Black Dragons.

Hakkai is shown to be a timid but friendly guy. When it comes to his personality he is nothing like his older brother Taiju who is disciplined and bloodlusted.

Hakkai has deep admiration for [Takashi Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/167841/Takashi-Mitsuya)
The younger sister of [Taiju Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Shiba-Taiju) and the elder sister of [Hakkai Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/167842/Shiba-Hakkai).

One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school.
~!
It's revealed that he is the person who pushed Takemichi in front of the train at the start of the story.!~

__Height:__ 174 cm Koko sees the world as a series of calculations. He acts solely in his own interests; every move of his is to benefit himself. He cozies up to those more powerful than he, but will turn his back on them the moment they lose their instrumentality. ~!Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander!~ ~!His goal was to collect 40 million yen to save his loved one, Akane but unfortunately, he was too late.!~

__Height:__ 172 cm

Vice captain of the 5th division in the Tokyo Manji Gang.
Older brother of [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano).

__Height:__ 172 cm

A Tenjiku executive. Ran's younger brother.

~!He's a Bonten executive in the future.!~

__Height:__ 198 cm

The Black Dragon's 10th leader and [Hakkai's](https://anilist.co/character/167842/Hakkai-Shiba) and [Yuzuha's](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) elder brother.

Taiju is brutal and abusive. He enjoys tormenting his opponents and has little care for others' wellbeing, even his own siblings'. He doesn't care who his opponent is regardless of gender. He is Catholic and has a cross tattooed on his back.

__Height:__ 183 cm

A Tenjiku executive. [Rindou](https://anilist.co/character/203563/Haitani-Rindou)'s elder brother.

~!He is a member of the S62 generation. He was one of Tenjiku’s 4 Heavenly Kings, and is a Bonten executive in the future.!~

Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed. 

Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo.

~! He is also known for organizing the murder of Hinata Tachibana many times. !~ ~!He is later ran over and killed by a truck after a long chase!~
Takuya Yamamoto is one of Takemichi's middle school friends and also his childhood friend.
One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school.

[Inupi](https://anilist.co/character/170479/Seishu-Inui)'s elder sister.
~!She got involved in a house fire and passed away later due to the wounds.!~

Takemichis friend and a member of the Mizo Middle Five
